notes.title: 0.3.0 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[b]0.3.0 Patch Notes[/b]

[list]
[*]Added Snipe Ability
[*]Added Upgrade Chapters 5 and 6
[*]Added Difficulty Chapters 7 to 9
[*]Added custom cursor while in a level
[*]Rebalanced rewards to reduce extreme currency drop scaling
[*]The player now starts out with perfect aim, so there is no projectile spread in the first 2 Difficulty Chapters
[*]The condition if a player is shooting is no longer depending on pressing LMB, but instead depends on Attack Speed (just like Power)
[*]Displaying the continue button in Upgrade Menu more clearly
[*]Improved ui performance
[/list]
